usage: 阿爸 is a casual and affectionate way to say 'dad' in Cantonese, often used by children and family members.
You can use 阿爸 to directly address your father or when talking about him to others.
This word is informal, so it's best used in relaxed, family settings rather than formal occasions.
阿爸 functions as a noun and can appear as the subject or object in a sentence.
It is common to add possessive particles like 嘅 (ge3) to show relationship, for example, '我嘅阿爸' means 'my dad'.
